## Appearance

Stacy has fair, curly hair, which is described as being remarkably lovely. She also possesses captivating, fascinating eyes.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)_

Stacy is a bright and sympathetic young woman. She possesses a natural ability to easily win and maintain the affection of her pupils.

## History

Miss Muriel Stacy was hired as the new female teacher for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. Upon returning to school in October, her students quickly became fond of her, and she organized a project for a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert. Later, Miss Stacy visited [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to propose forming an advanced class to prepare students for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination. At the end of the term, she reassured her students that she would return the following year to continue preparing them for the exams, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resumed her studies under Miss Stacy after the summer.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXII. Anne Is Invited Out to Tea P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--stacy.md)

Miss Stacy serves as Anne's inspiring teacher and mentor, with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) quickly developing a strong fondness for her upon returning to school. Miss Stacy encourages Anne's academic potential by organizing an advanced Queen's class to prepare her and other students for the entrance examinations, while also providing reassurances and guiding her studies.
